description: Life comes in waves , preparation always sees me through. #selflove #selfdiscovery #intentionalliving
transcript: I've learned to accept that life comes in waves. The more that I reflect on that, it keeps me in a constant state of preparation. Preparation looks like not grieving a future that does not exist. It looks like staying in this present moment, and it looks like being able to figure things out no matter what the circumstances. We can truly have it all, but not at the same time. Life comes in waves, and what a gift that is.
